profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Cloud Security Software Engineer focused on automating and enforcing Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) in AWS and Azure at Deere. I develop systems to enhance cloud network security, leveraging automation, containerization, and scalable architectures. My expertise spans cloud development, security automation, and web application development, with a strong interest in Python and modern cloud-native technologies.

positions.title: Cloud Security Software Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure and +6 skills

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed GHA workflows in collaboration with team members, leveraging boto3, to efficiently identify VPC resources utilizing BIND servers for DNS resolution, thus reducing processing time from 4-5 hours to 5-10 minutes for resource data from hundreds of accounts within an organization. 
• Contributed to the removal of over 110,000 security vulnerabilities in AWS environments by successfully automating the removal of BIND DNS servers, which directly improved the security posture of the organization. 
• Modernized team CI/CD tooling by migrating 50% of the team GitHub repos using Jenkins over to GitHub Actions. 
• Refactored core VPC creation automation to facilitate accurate and efficient deployment of AWS Business Unit Transit Gateways & Transit Gateway Route Tables used for shared NAT infrastructure to reduce annual NAT gateway costs by ~$1.6M. Validated accuracy of AWS resource deployment by creating integration tests using LocalStack. 
• Implemented centralized feature toggles system within the OneCloud team leveraging the Flipt open-source project to enable a robust and efficient system that utilizes Git/GitHub for backend storage. 
• Migrated multiple legacy Java Spring Boot APIs supporting the MyCloud application from vulnerable EC2 infra to ECS. Worked with principal engineer to enable hosted based routing using Envoy.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloud Computing and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated data from 200+ dealer-facing application monitors into a Grafana platform to provide greater application availability and performance observability. Spearheaded the development of custom PowerShell endpoints within PowerShell Function App to pair with the Grafana Simple JSON Data Source Plugin.
• Collaborated with Channel Operations team to onboard and establish availability and performance monitoring using Dotcom Monitor and AppDynamics for 12 Ecommerce teams. 
• Proactively responded to outages and impairments for 200+ dealer-facing applications by communicating with application teams, Tier 1/2 support teams, and 16K+ users daily. Redefined incident escalation process between Tier 1/2 and Tier 3 support teams. 
• Utilized Terraform to create a self-service solution allowing app teams to create their own DotCom API monitors, thus tracking the availability of their backend servers and microservices, resulting 100+ hours saved in monitor configuration and manual deployment.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted in teaching incoming freshmen elementary software development tools including SSH, Unix and Linux terminal, text editors, IDEs, and version control systems, specifically Git.
• Led and directed two PSO sections of around 80 students weekly.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a JSON form builder for Prosodica support engineers to create and update existing forms in live production Prosodica databases.
• Utilized Typescript, JavaScript, React, NestJS, and SQL to reduce the time needed to prepare and manage customer forms by 50%.
• Wrote Cypress frontend tests and Jest backend tests to improve code coverage by 25%.
